$comment: Contract of the Overlay blocks. Each block is the system's Modal (Modal · ModalHeader · Content slot · ModalFooter · CloseButton) filled with escala-ui components; six blocks are the Modal with Layout=simple (400 wide) and the rest Layout=tray (480 wide). Motion: the Modal's own choreography (dialog-enter / exit); a block adds none.

blocks.name: ConfirmDialog
anatomy: Modal (Layout simple, 400 wide: one padded card)
ModalFooter (Layout equal: two buttons of one width)
a11y: Rendered as the Modal: dialog role, focus trap and Escape when not inline
The header's title names the dialog
Destructive and warning actions stay disabled until the user confirms the risk
